services.name: Marble & mosaic floors
services.source: Observed directly in the business's own Google Maps photos: a marble foyer with a mosaic medallion, a gold-fixture marble bathroom vanity, and a worker hand-setting mosaic tile around a stone garden fountain.

services.name: Tile installation (bathrooms/kitchens)
services.source: Google category is 'Tile contractor'; photos show hexagon mosaic shower tile, penny-tile shower work, and a remodeled bathroom with tile and granite counters.

services.name: Hardwood floor remodeling
services.source: Review from Alexandra Leon: 'From having plain white floors, to these beautiful aesthetic wood floors, I fell in love with it.'

services.name: Outdoor stone work (fountains, patios, pool decks)
services.source: Google Maps photos show the crew installing checkered marble tile on a pool deck and mosaic stonework on a garden fountain surround.

no_price_list: No services menu or price list is published anywhere (no website, no Google Business menu section). Site uses the adapted variant: 'priced on request' + call-for-quote CTA throughout, per pipeline rule.

reviews_used.author: Ashley Luna
reviews_used.text: This team remodeled our house floors and did an amazing job I like the fact that it was a family business and when they give you a time frame they deliver 100% recommend them. I wish the best definitely will tell others about this!

reviews_used.author: Alexandra Leon
reviews_used.text: Everything from top to bottom was perfect! The employees were extremely proficient and skilled in remaking my floors. From having plain white floors, to these beautiful aesthetic wood floors, I fell in love with it. Thank you for the great work!

reviews_used.author: Crystal Aquino
reviews_used.text: Great customer service and wonderful work! I recommend their services to everyone!

reviews_source: scripts/gmaps_reviews.js scrape of the Google Maps reviews tab for this listing. Two additional real reviews not used on the site: E G ('amazing job on my new kitchen floor') and Ismael Tuiran ('Superbly craftsmanship very professional').

photos_used.source: scripts/gmaps_photocycle.js photo-viewer cycle on the Google Maps listing, 11 photos retrieved. Each photo was visually reviewed with the Read tool before selection; two were excluded from the gallery as not meeting the quality bar: a stock-looking two-photo composite with no visible connection to a real jobsite, and a demolition/debris shot.
